features.title: Undo and redo a turn: conversation and files together
features.summary: Each turn start snapshots the thread's workspace through the VCS provider (a jj operation in a jj workspace, a snapshot commit in git) before any of its tool calls run. Undo restores that snapshot, continues in a fork of the conversation cut before the turn and archives the original; redo restores the files the undo replaced and brings the original back.
failureModes: Undo and redo are refused while the thread runs.
A fork that fails after the files were restored puts the files back before reporting the error.
A folder no VCS provider claims records turns without files; undo then rewinds only the conversation.
A new turn in the forked thread drops its redo.
A file restore is refused while another live thread works in the same folder, unless the caller passes allowSharedDirectory: true.
reach: hover button "Redo the undone turn and its files"
expect text "Redo the undone turn and its files"

features.title: Rewind to before any recorded turn, files included
features.summary: The composer's Rewind menu lists every recorded turn. Rewind to here confirms which turns leave the conversation, restores the workspace files to the snapshot taken when that turn started, continues in a fork cut before it and archives the original; redo brings every rewound turn and its files back. A file restore is refused while another live thread works in the same folder (it would overwrite that thread's edits), with an explicit Rewind anyway override.
features.currentSurface: composer: Rewind to an earlier turn
failureModes: Rewind is refused while the thread runs.
A turn with no checkpoint is refused with the list of recorded turns.
Another live thread in the same folder (or one inside it) refuses the file restore until the user chooses Rewind anyway; the thread's own subagents do not count.
An unreadable live-thread list refuses the restore rather than guessing, with the same explicit override.
A fork that fails after the files were restored puts the files back before reporting the error.
reach: fill textbox "commands, @ files or sessions*" "Add a second turn to rewind past"
click button "Rewind to an earlier turn"

verification.testName: rewinds to an earlier turn with its files, and redo brings every later turn back
